purpose: Pins the artifacts that are visual acceptance authority for DDE. Read by scripts/golden_visual.py and tests/unit/test_golden_visual_manifest.py. An entry whose artifact is absent is reported as ARTIFACT_MISSING and fails closed: no pixel-reference conformance may be claimed against it.

artifacts.state_note: The approved image has never existed in this repository's git history (verified 2026-09-04 by `git log --all --name-only` over every path). Project Truth describes it in prose across FRONTEND_STUDIO_REV3.md, ARCHITECTURE_DECISIONS.md AD-035 and DEV_PLAN_REV3.md, but prose is not pixels. Until the owner commits the file at expected_path and records its sha256 here, DDE may claim STRUCTURAL conformance to the normative measurements in FRONTEND_STUDIO_REV3.md Part I sections 2-5 only, never PIXEL-REFERENCE conformance to the approved image.
